title: SynthesisJudgments
description: Harness-returned synthesis judgments (synthesis.json). Contains one entry per synthesis-driven section; validated by the Python pipeline on --continue before merging into the rendered PLAYBOOK.md. Malformed input → exit 3.

sections.description: Map from section-number string to the harness-authored content for that section. Keys are constrained to the five synthesis-driven sections (§1, §2, §8, §14, §15). A missing key causes the pipeline to fall back to the deterministic ⚠ UNVERIFIED stub for that section rather than failing.

SynthesisSection.title: SynthesisSection
SynthesisSection.description: Harness-authored content for one synthesis-driven playbook section.

body.description: Markdown prose for the section. Should be within the word_budget stated in the corresponding SectionPrompt. Non-obvious claims must be backed by path:line citations listed in citations.

citations.description: List of path:line references grounding claims in the body. Each entry must resolve to a real file in code_root (validated by Phase D refcheck, not by schema validation).
